posts.title: Run a GitHub Actions workflow manually with workflow_dispatch
posts.description: workflow_dispatch adds a Run workflow button and a gh command for running a GitHub Actions workflow by hand, which let me stop running CI on every push to main.

posts.title: SSH keys in the Mac’s Secure Enclave without third-party tools
posts.description: macOS Tahoe can make an SSH key that lives in the Secure Enclave and asks for Touch ID on every login, using only sc_auth and ssh-keychain.dylib.

posts.title: Running Qwen 3.8 27B on a 16 GB GPU
posts.description: A 4-bit quant fits a dense 27B on a 16 GB card, and hybrid attention leaves room for 64K of context. The compose file, and how to turn thinking off.
